title: Inserted-zero contraction of every pinned polynomial model
statement: For a prime $\ell$, any normed field $F$ with a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra structure, any $r\in\mathbf N$, and every Model $P$ of [def-sfb-homogeneous-polynomial-resolution-data], there exists a Contraction of $P$ in that same specification. Its maps are underlying internal-module maps, with the precise monomial zero-evaluation and insertZero formulas, and satisfy the split, degree-zero and all positive-degree contraction identities. Equivariance of these maps is not claimed. This statement does not construct a Model or assert that its augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: Insertion of the zero tuple gives the displayed $h^n$ by step 2 and is compatible with every parameter restriction. It fixes coefficients, so $h$ is internal $A$-linear after forgetting actions. On constants $h^0a(c)=c$. For $f\in K^0(S)$, $h^1\delta^0f(y_0)=\delta^0f(0,y_0)=f(y_0)-f(0)$ and $ah^0f(y_0)=f(0)$. Adding proves $ah^0+h^1\delta^0=1$. No action compatibility of $h$ is used.

proof.text:
For $n>0$, expand the two composites on $f\in K^n(S)$:
$$h^{n+1}\delta^nf(y_0,\ldots,y_n)=f(y_0,\ldots,y_n)+\sum_{j=0}^{n}(-1)^{j+1}f(0,y_0,\ldots,\widehat y_j,\ldots,y_n),$$
$$\delta^{n-1}h^nf(y_0,\ldots,y_n)=\sum_{j=0}^{n}(-1)^jf(0,y_0,\ldots,\widehat y_j,\ldots,y_n).$$
Each summand cancels its partner, leaving $f$. These are polynomial identities over every $A(S)$, natural in $S$, hence equalities of internal morphisms. This proves exactly $\delta^{n-1}h^n+h^{n+1}\delta^n=1$.

proof.text: By uniqueness out of each monomial coproduct, the polynomial identities are internal-map equalities. Assemble h0, h and their formulas into Contraction. The sole rank-zero monomial is constant, so all identities remain valid at r=0.
